review: ReplaceForContext deletes then reinserts the entire context in a store transaction/savepoint; no per-row prior images in the domain audit.
Delete/reassign can change placements, override categories and collection defaults; a category audit is not the resulting row set.
Independent upsert/delete by model/category/collection; parent operations can remove placements.
Store deletes owned overrides before collection deletion; referenced placements/defaults require explicit accounting.
Broader edge insert/delete and scheme ownership must be captured separately from referenced concept bodies.
Entry edits/removals/reorder; baseline FK deletes entries with list. Reorder affects several rows.
Direct writes; delete checks use then removes list and cascading entries.
Fork creation has no standalone audit kind; provenance receipt is distinct from copied content.
UpdateWithValues deletes and reinserts values; delete of example cascades values. Preserve exact numeric/date/JSON nulls.
Store transaction/savepoint combines header and values, without a domain audit entry.
Save diff logs domain override payloads; deletes cascade refs; nullable captured fields are not all represented.
Field create/save can also write base override; parent field audit does not identify all storage effects.
Delete removes overrides in a store transaction/savepoint, then model; references cascade from overrides.
Individual binding audit; complete effective inventory includes global/system/ontology policy outside a project operation.
SetRefs logs parent override update; previous payload explicitly omits refs. FK cascade deletes refs with override.
Project/actor association query exists without an emitting audit service kind.
Create/update/delete and two-phase reorder call store directly; composite row keys may move.
Add/remove/reorder/primary normalize siblings and project parent column; source pin changes interpretation context too.
Link/unlink/primary have domain audits; selected publications, defaults and semantic resolutions need explicit context images.
Create/update/about/delete plus inherited parent synchronization; project deletion may orphan pending sets.
Vocabulary writes/imports have no standalone audit kind; owned entries are separate rows.
Entry upserts/local term creation and connector cache writes do not supply attributed before/after images.
